quickref.name: No Bear's Land (originally "Battlefield Airpad")
quickref.era: BBR 1.0 launch map, Oct 8, 2011, as 'Battlefield Airpad' [Fan-wiki]; official BBR trailer of Nov 23, 2011 shows its trench [Canon/Observed]. Renamed at the v2.0 BBR→BBG switch, about May–Jun 2013 (wiki page moved 2013-06-04) [Fan-wiki]. Reskins: winter 2.26 (Jan 17, 2017; back in 2.28, Dec 20, 2017), summer 2.27 (May 29, 2017), spring 2.51 (Apr 13, 2018) [Fan-wiki, Updates]. BBG 3.0 'New Map Lighting' (Nov 2021) applied game-wide [Fan-wiki].
quickref.in_2026: Returning [Canon]: Steam copy says 'jump back into classics such as No Bears Land…'; track 2 'No Bears Land' (0:44) on the 2026 OST. SkyVu's 'Official Playtest Highlights' thumbnail (C7uFxvSZ10c) is set on a No Bear's Land keep roof, and fan playtest thumbnails from Aug–Oct 2026 show it [Observed]. Not in the Steam trailer or screenshots [Observed]. 2026 modes on this map and seasonal reskins: unknown.
quickref.setting: Square, open, sunlit grass plateau, a WWI 'No Man's Land' pun [Fan-wiki]. Red base keep at one end and Blue at the other, each an octagonal olive concrete tower joined to a gun battlement, with a jump pad at the back. Zig-zag, plank-floored trenches run to a centre pillar holding the Bearscream Sandwich. Two crashed Pelican't dropships lie on the other two sides (red-banded west, blue-banded east) with super jump pads. Rotationally symmetric [Observed top-down; Fan-wiki].
quickref.palette_and_lighting: High midday sun, crisp shadows, saturated blue sky (#2F6BC9→#7797EA in 2012; #6D89E6 in 2026) with soft cumulus and faint misty hills on the horizon. Yellow-green daisy-flecked turf (#728817; top-down albedo #A4BE11). Golden plank trenches (#A68231–#EFC736) with soil bands: orange #D66F19, brown #724017, near-black #1C1511. Olive concrete keeps (lit #635E35, shade #2E2B14) with a red stripe #CD5433 or a blue band. Gunmetal Pelican'ts #44453E. Tan sandbags #89641A–#967521. Winter: snow #FEFEFF with ice-cyan sandbags. Summer: pale sand, turquoise water, orange umbrellas #D55C25, blue bridges #306DA6 [Observed, approximate].
quickref.landmarks: 1) Red and Blue base keeps: octagonal, cobbled roof with a round pad, gun battlement, cracked double-door face, team stripes, stencil 'XEL-PMOC 20-11'. 2) Zig-zag trenches: plank floors, striped soil walls, sandbag arcs. 3) Two crashed four-engine Pelican'ts with long dirt furrows, snapped-off engine pods, health packs and super jump pads on top. 4) Centre pillar with the Bearscream Sandwich and twin jump pads. 5) Food stands: red-and-yellow canopy over a grey cart with a drumstick-mascot emblem, hiding the Imperial Basket Grande. 6) Black X-shaped tank traps and dark corner pylons with team lights [Observed; Fan-wiki].
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: Jump pads behind each keep (to the roof), beside the centre pillar, and on each Pelican't (a high launch to the opposite wreck) [Fan-wiki]. Pickups: Bearscream Sandwich ×1, Imperial Basket Grande ×2, Health Pack ×2 (on the wrecks), Shield ×2 (on the keep roofs). PTB: bomb tubes on the keep roofs, bombs in the centre trenches [Fan-wiki]. Infobox 'Suicide: Yes' is unexplained. Long sightlines favour Sniper and Demo [Fan-wiki]. Easter eggs: the No Man's Land pun; the Pelican't as a Halo Pelican pun with a design based on Aliens' UD-4 Cheyenne [Fan-wiki]; the 'War. What is it good for?' blurb [Canon per notes, Unverified]; a cartoon fossil bone in the trench soil in a 2012 render [Observed]; the drumstick mascot next to the fried-food basket pickup [Observed/Inference]; a Christmas tree on the pillar in the winter reskin.

corrections.current_text: **No Bear's Land**: a grassy WWI-style trench field with two downed Pelican'ts.
corrections.correction: Keep, but make it precise. 'WWI' is the wiki's reading of the 'No Man's Land' name pun; the props mix WWI trenches and sandbags with Czech-hedgehog tank traps and sci-fi dropships. Add the layout: a square, rotationally symmetric field with Red and Blue base keeps (octagonal tower plus gun battlement) at opposite ends; two crashed Pelican'ts (red-banded west, blue-banded east) on the other sides with super jump pads; plank-floored zig-zag trenches leading to a centre pillar with the Bearscream Sandwich. Add the era: launched as 'Battlefield Airpad' in BBR 1.0 (Oct 2011), renamed at 2.0 (about May–Jun 2013); reskins winter 2.26 (Jan 2017, back in 2.28 Dec 2017), summer 2.27 (May 2017), spring 2.51 (Apr 2018).
corrections.evidence: Wiki 'No Bear's Land' page text and move log ('Battlefield Airpad' → 'No Bear's Land', 2013-06-04); File:Battlefield.png top-down and the Battlefield_Airpad1-3 renders (viewed); wiki Updates table rows 2.26, 2.27, 2.28 and 2.51; BBR Version 1.0 page.

corrections.current_text: [OFFICIAL] "No Bears Land" and "Steamyard Blues" (Steam 2026) vs "No Bear's Land" (official 2014 page; wiki)
corrections.correction: Add the in-game BBG map-select tile, which reads "NO BEAR'S LAND" (2013), as the strongest evidence for the apostrophe spelling. Also note that the 2026 OST track is titled "No Bears Land", matching the store copy.

corrections.current_text: [FAN-WIKI] The Pelican't is "a dark green ship, with four engines on the sides of the vehicle".
corrections.correction: Add the observed look on No Bear's Land: dark olive-grey/gunmetal hulls, each with four fat cylindrical engine pods on stub wings. The two wrecks carry team-colour bands (red on the west wreck, blue on the east), lie in opposite directions, and each has a snapped-off engine pod and a long ploughed dirt furrow.
